comment: I loved her teaching style. Classes are lecture-based, but there's always a handout with practice problems that you do right after learning a topic. This makes it very easy to remember things you learn. You have to participate once per class, which makes it easy to stay engaged. She's also really good at explaining concepts.

Her class was pretty easy, and she was a good teacher. A chunk of your grade is participation, which is ambiguous. My participation grade lined up with the "doesn't participate" category, while many of my classmates who participated far less in class received grades much higher than mine. She def had clear favorites, and the grades reflected it.

She is not understanding at all and grades extremely harshly. She expects you to walk in and be an expert on everything economics. No matter how hard you work, the grade you get will not reflect your effort. This is was unexpected and unlike the other PPEL professors. Her grading scale is unclear and she refuses to round up too.
Dr. McCrary is very nice and cares about her students success. Her 363 class is tough but fair. Go to office hours she wants to help you.

Solid prof. You know what you are getting, but pretty average across the board. The thing that irks me is that a 94 and above is an "A." (she won't round up or allow for EC). Classes are repetitive but occasionally very interesting. Nothing sensational to say, but nothing really bad either. Sometimes nitpicky with details and requirements.

Frankly she should not be a teacher. If you disagree with her opinions she will argue with you in class and take it out on you with her grading. 35 percent of ur grade is purely how much she likes you. I have never hated a teacher so much nor had so many people in my class hate a teacher like this. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS
So chill, very structured and easy to digest. A bit boring at times, but what class isn't
The entire course is planned well and every lecture is posted in annotated form. The grading breakdown is clear. There are ample office hours. Well organized and no surprises. Highly recommend.

Dr. McCrary was definitely one of the best professors I've ever had! I took her for PPEL 363, and her lectures were always clear and helpful, so even if you didn't fully understand the readings, her explanations made it easy to grasp the material. Interesting class and tests were easy to study for. Highly recommend her!

Dr. McCrary is a great professor. Super sweet, willing to sit down and help you, and very understanding. Her lectures are very concise. No superfluous content or confusing pedagogy. Her grading policy is forgiving as she drops your worst quiz and worst two homeworks.I would recommend to all. If you get less than an A in this class, it's your fault.

dr mccrary is very intelligent and def one of the easier profs for econ 101, she is very sweet and always available to give you extra help if you need it! her exams are essentially the exact same as the study guides, so as long as you study those, you will be fine.

Dr. McCrary is a genuinely good person who wants to see each of her students succeed. If you do the work and participate, getting an A should be pretty easy. Study well for quizzes and use her if you're struggling. If you have the chance to take her for econ, I would absolutely recommend!

She is AMAZING. So clear and concise when teaching you the material and ensures you are prepared for the tests/quizzes. She is also super caring and a really nice person. It felt like she wanted every student to succeed and her classroom was a very positive place. Definitely try to take her for ECON 101

McCrary is an incredible professor and person. She makes Econ 101, a class that is typically considered difficult, accessible and enjoyable. Her exams are fair and she offers tons of materials to help you study. She's a professor who wants all of her students to succeed.

One of my favorite teachers at UR. I wish she taught more classes, she has the most amazing lectures and explains a complicated subject so well. She is knowledgeable, but also caring and an amazing person to talk and make jokes with. Participation matters, and exams are a large portion of your grade, but if you study they are easy. I LOVE HER!

I absolutely loved taking ECON101 with Dr. McCrary! She is an incredible professor who makes the content personable and accessible. Her assignments are straightforward and great preparation for biweekly quizzes. She gives ample opportunities to succeed in her class through practice and office hours.

Dr. McCrary is an awesome micro professor. Her lectures are very clear and she uses helpful real-life examples to explain different topics. There's online hw once a week but you get five attempts for each question so it's pretty easy to do well. A younger professor that is personable and kind. Definitely the best micro prof I've heard about!

She is a great micro professor and I would definitely recommend taking her class! Her lectures are very clear and limited to only the information that we need to know for tests. Her tests are very fair with minimal homework. She is a newer professor and makes consistent efforts to take student feedback into consideration.

BEST ECON PROFESSOR!! I had her for micro having never taken economics and she makes everything so easy to understand. She gives comprehensive study guides for quizzes and exams, and she isn't a difficult grader. Her lectures are concise, and they cover everything you need to know for the exams.
Best professor I've had

Prof. McCrary was an amazing professor for an intro Econ class. She gave the perfect amount of detail without overcomplicating. Homework was super minimal and exams were very easy to prepare for. I'd recommend ten times out of ten

Her lectures were very clear, and there was minimal homework. She also gave us a practice test before each midterm and final that was almost identical to the test. She's very available outside of class to answer questions and is overall a very nice person who wants you to do well in her class. I would recommend for an easy micro class.

Doctor McCrary is an awesome Microeconomics teacher. She is so caring and really wants you to do well. Homework assignments are easy to complete and there are practice problems done during class throughout the lesson. One of my favorite professors and highly recommend her for Econ101!!!
